letter:
My dearest Liza, my jaan, my forever cutie,  
Each sunrise in Dubai and each monsoon breeze in Ahmedabad reminds me how lucky I am to share this beautiful chaos with you. I still marvel at how our wedding day—23 Feb— feels like a secret bookmark in the story of us, a reminder that love only grows richer with every sunset we chase together. Thank you for filling my life with laughter, warmth, and endless adventure. I love you more than words can capture, today and always.
poem:
Across the dunes or by the river’s flow,  
Your smile’s the compass that I always know.  
In every season, my heart sings anew,  
Forever yours, my love, forever true.
